title: Double Stonecutter Shelves
description: A version of Stonecutter Shelves that gives you twice the amount of shelves!
body: This datapack is a version of [Stonecutter Shelves by lark2bird](https://modrinth.com/datapack/stonecutter-shelves), but you craft two shelves instead of one with this version, to go in line with another datapack of mine: [Double Shelf Crafting](https://modrinth.com/datapack/double-shelf-crafting).
